descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING! This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization. Key
• Responsibilities Perform maintenance and technical support on installed products and equipment. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve malfunctions. Determine when products should be upgraded or replaced. Provide onsite training for customer support personnel. Coordinate with engineering teams for complex issues. Skills &
• Qualifications Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role. Strong technical and diagnostic skills. Ability to work independently in field environments. Good communication and customer service skills. Familiarity with installation and calibration procedures. What we offer you Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
